data.name: Khayriyyah
data.gender_notes: Khayriyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘khayr’ meaning ‘goodness’, ‘excellence’, or ‘mercy’. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person who is kind, generous, and blessed. The name Khayriyyah carries the meaning “Goodness, Excellence, Mercy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khayriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody goodness, excellence, mercy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khayriyyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
